cells.gaps: The share is of May 2021 and its denominator is derived: 998 stations with ICDMS plus 159 without, 1 157 by addition, where the same meeting's plan counts 1 156. The newest stations facts disagree with it in kind: the reply of 31 December 2025 gives no count (ZAF-009), and the 2023/24 baseline of 68% (789 of 1 160) counts stations using one ICDMS function, not stations registering dockets (ZAF-010). No fact names the occurrence or complaint as first recorded as digital, none gives a rural share, and none shows the docket passing digitally to prosecutor or court; the finance row names no budget line for the docket system; the one advancing event, 11 April 2025, falls outside the twelve months.
cells.note: C is captured at the station on CAS/ICDMS and verified on the same system at provincial and national level, in 998 of 1 157 stations. Not 5: O is not established, the share is under 90 per cent, and the figure is older than two years and gives no rural share.
